name: abasto
description: Abasto: red mayorista B2B de Bolivia. Monorepo con servicios, apps, contratos e infraestructura.

scripts.infra: docker compose up -d --wait postgres mongo dynamodb rabbitmq keycloak jaeger router && node infra/dynamodb/crear-tablas.mjs
scripts.todo: docker compose --profile servicios up -d --build --wait && node infra/dynamodb/crear-tablas.mjs && node infra/keycloak/al-dia.mjs
scripts.n8n: docker compose --profile n8n up -d --wait n8n && docker compose exec n8n n8n import:workflow --separate --input=/flujos
scripts.supergrafo: rover supergraph compose --config infra/router/supergraph.yaml --output infra/router/supergraph.graphql --elv2-license accept
scripts.test:catalogo: docker compose run --rm --no-deps catalogo composer test
scripts.test:todo: pnpm test && pnpm test:pedidos && pnpm test:catalogo && pnpm test:ml
scripts.semilla: docker compose exec catalogo php artisan catalogo:semilla && docker compose exec catalogo php artisan catalogo:semilla-abasto
